name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Payments Operations & Implementation | Client Onboarding, Stripe Setup, Troubleshooting & Integrations
summary: Implementation and onboarding specialist who takes clients from sales handover through go-live and keeps them running after. At Wix I launched 25+ clients a month, up to ~25 at once, at 110% of implementation targets. I've set up and worked in Stripe, walked clients through invoicing and billing workflows at Accelo, and debug integrations myself through webhooks, REST APIs, and JSON. I track every requirement, blocker, and follow-up until it's closed.

Set up and validate data imports into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, re-checking every import for accuracy.
Document every client interaction, status, and deliverable, keeping records auditable across concurrent engagements.
